expectedResults: The displayed and rendered frequency is identical on iPhone and Watch for the same validated profile and system data.
Mismatch and unavailable states are visible before unsafe playback; stopped selection and relaunch never start audio unexpectedly.
notes: Planned for SP-034; not executed. Simulator and paired/physical Watch results are separate evidence classes.
objective: Verify profile tuning-system resolution reaches truthful iPhone and Watch presentation and playback inputs.
steps: Compare displayed and renderer-input frequencies on iPhone and Watch for named, direct, and system-degree entries from one profile snapshot.
Select a pitch while stopped and confirm silence; select a profile with a mismatched system/reference and verify disclosure before Play.
While playing, change pitch and confirm direct transition; change profile and confirm stop-before-selection; terminate and relaunch and confirm selection restores silently.
Stage a valid replica, then reject an incompatible or unresolved candidate and confirm the last valid Watch replica and its playback inputs remain intact.
title: iPhone and Watch profile resolution integration
